question.en: Do I Qualify for Medicare Extra Help (LIS) in Utah in 2026?
question.es: ¿Califico para la Ayuda Adicional de Medicare (LIS) en Utah en 2026?

shortAnswer.en: Yes, if income is under $23,940 (single) or $32,460 (couple) in 2026.
shortAnswer.es: Sí, si sus ingresos son menores a $23,940 (soltero) o $32,460 (pareja) en 2026.

fullAnswer.en: Yes. Utah Medicare beneficiaries qualify for Extra Help in 2026 with income below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level, $23,940 for a single person or $32,460 for a married couple, and resources under $16,590 single or $33,100 married. Utahns already enrolled in Utah Medicaid or a Utah Medicare Savings Program (QMB, SLMB, or QI) are deemed eligible automatically. Everyone else applies through Social Security or Utah's myCase portal.
fullAnswer.es: Sí. Los beneficiarios de Medicare en Utah califican para la Ayuda Adicional en 2026 con ingresos menores al 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, $23,940 para una persona soltera o $32,460 para una pareja casada, y recursos menores a $16,590 soltero o $33,100 casado. Los residentes de Utah ya inscritos en Medicaid de Utah o en un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Utah son elegibles automáticamente.

h1.en: Medicare Extra Help (LIS) Income Limits in Utah (2026)
h1.es: Limites de Ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional de Medicare (LIS) en Utah (2026)

introParagraphs.en: Utah has more than 500,000 Medicare beneficiaries, and many qualify for Extra Help, the federal Low-Income Subsidy (LIS) that pays most of the Part D premium, waives the deductible, and caps drug copays. The income and resource limits are set nationally by the Social Security Administration, but Utah residents have a distinct path into the program through Utah Medicaid, the state's Medicaid agency, which automatically deems many low-income Utahns eligible through its Medicare Savings Program.
introParagraphs.es: Utah tiene mas de 500,000 beneficiarios de Medicare, y muchos califican para la Ayuda Adicional, el Subsidio Federal de Bajos Ingresos (LIS) que paga la mayor parte de la prima de la Parte D, elimina el deducible y limita los copagos de medicamentos. Los limites de ingresos y recursos los fija la Administracion del Seguro Social a nivel nacional, pero los residentes de Utah tienen una via distinta hacia el programa a traves de Medicaid de Utah.

introParagraphs.en: Utah residents will find the exact 2026 Extra Help income limits by household size below, along with how Utah Medicaid enrollment or a Utah Medicare Savings Program grants automatic eligibility, and the step-by-step application process for those who need to apply directly. For income limits on Utah's Medicaid program itself, see [Medicaid income limits](/en/medicaid-income-limits). To check multiple programs at once, use the [Benefits Screener](/en/screener).
introParagraphs.es: Esta pagina detalla los limites exactos de ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional de 2026 por tamano de hogar, como la inscripcion en Medicaid de Utah o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Utah otorga elegibilidad automatica, y el proceso de solicitud paso a paso para los residentes de Utah que necesitan solicitar directamente.

heading.es: Respuesta Directa para Residentes de Utah

paragraphs.en: Yes. Utah Medicare beneficiaries qualify for Extra Help in 2026 if household income is below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level ($23,940 single, $32,460 married) and countable resources stay under $16,590 single or $33,100 married. Utahns on Utah Medicaid or a Utah Medicare Savings Program are deemed eligible automatically, with no separate application required.
paragraphs.es: Si. Los beneficiarios de Medicare en Utah califican para la Ayuda Adicional en 2026 si el ingreso del hogar es menor al 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($23,940 soltero, $32,460 casado) y los recursos contables son menores a $16,590 soltero o $33,100 casado.

heading.en: Utah Extra Help Income Limits by Household Size (2026)
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional en Utah por Tamano del Hogar (2026)

paragraphs.en: Utah uses the same nationwide Extra Help income thresholds that apply in all 48 contiguous states and D.C., since Utah is not Alaska or Hawaii (the two states with higher federal poverty guidelines). The table below shows the 2026 limits at 150% of the Federal Poverty Level for every household size, along with the monthly equivalent Utah applicants can compare against a pay stub or benefit statement.
paragraphs.es: Utah usa los mismos umbrales de ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional a nivel nacional que aplican en los 48 estados contiguos y D.C., ya que Utah no es Alaska ni Hawaii (los dos estados con pautas de pobreza federales mas altas). La tabla siguiente muestra los limites de 2026 al 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza para cada tamano de hogar.

heading.en: Utah Resource (Asset) Limits for Extra Help in 2026
heading.es: Limites de Recursos (Activos) para la Ayuda Adicional en Utah en 2026

paragraphs.en: Utah applicants must also pass a resource test: countable assets below $16,590 for a single person or $33,100 for a married couple in 2026. Countable resources include checking and savings accounts, CDs, stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and IRA or 401(k) balances not yet in payout status. A Utah applicant's home, one vehicle, and personal belongings do not count toward the limit.
paragraphs.es: Los solicitantes en Utah tambien deben pasar una prueba de recursos: activos contables por debajo de $16,590 para una persona soltera o $33,100 para una pareja casada en 2026. Los recursos contables incluyen cuentas corrientes y de ahorro, CD, acciones, bonos, fondos mutuos y saldos de IRA o 401(k) que no esten en fase de pago.

paragraphs.en: If a Utah applicant notifies Social Security of a burial set-aside, the resource limit rises to $18,090 single or $36,100 married, excluding up to $1,500 per person set aside for burial expenses from the countable total.
paragraphs.es: Si un solicitante en Utah notifica al Seguro Social sobre una reserva para gastos funerarios, el limite de recursos sube a $18,090 soltero o $36,100 casado, excluyendo hasta $1,500 por persona reservados para gastos de entierro del total contable.

heading.en: Utah Medicaid, Medicare Savings Programs, and Automatic Eligibility
heading.es: Medicaid de Utah, Programas de Ahorros de Medicare y Elegibilidad Automatica

paragraphs.en: Utah Medicaid, run by the Utah Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) with eligibility processed by the Department of Workforce Services (DWS), plays a direct role in Extra Help eligibility, not just Medicaid coverage. Utahns who have full Utah Medicaid coverage, receive Supplemental Security Income, or are enrolled in Utah's Medicare Savings Program (QMB, SLMB, or QI) are deemed eligible for Extra Help automatically. DWS sends the eligibility file to CMS, and no separate SSA application is needed for these Utah residents.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Utah, administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Utah (DHHS) con elegibilidad procesada por el Departamento de Servicios de la Fuerza Laboral (DWS), juega un papel directo en la elegibilidad para la Ayuda Adicional, no solo en la cobertura de Medicaid. Los residentes de Utah con Medicaid completo, Ingreso de Seguridad Suplementaria, o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Utah son elegibles automaticamente.

paragraphs.en: Utah's 2026 Medicare Savings Program income limits are $1,350 a month single or $1,824 married for QMB, $1,616 single or $2,184 married for SLMB, and $1,816 single or $2,455 married for QI, with a resource limit of $9,950 single or $14,910 married. QI is funded on a first-come, first-served basis each year, so Utah applicants near the QI limit should apply early in 2026.
paragraphs.es: Los limites de ingresos de 2026 del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Utah son $1,350 al mes soltero o $1,824 casado para QMB, $1,616 soltero o $2,184 casado para SLMB, y $1,816 soltero o $2,455 casado para QI, con un limite de recursos de $9,950 soltero o $14,910 casado.

paragraphs.en: Utah expanded Medicaid under the ACA effective January 1, 2020, so low-income Utah adults under 138% FPL (138% of the Federal Poverty Level, $22,025 for an individual in 2026) generally qualify for Utah Medicaid, not just Extra Help. Because Utah expanded, the state does not have the ACA coverage gap that exists in the 10 non-expansion states (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming). Note that Extra Help uses a higher 150% FPL income test and counts gross income directly, unlike ACA marketplace subsidies which use MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income).
paragraphs.es: Utah expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA a partir del 1 de enero de 2020, por lo que los adultos de bajos ingresos en Utah por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 para un individuo en 2026) generalmente califican para Medicaid de Utah. Debido a que Utah expandio, el estado no tiene la brecha de cobertura del ACA que existe en los 10 estados sin expansion.

heading.en: How Utah Residents Apply for Extra Help
heading.es: Como Solicitan los Residentes de Utah la Ayuda Adicional

paragraphs.en: Utah residents who are not already deemed eligible through Utah Medicaid, SSI, or a Medicare Savings Program can apply for Extra Help through two channels: directly with Social Security, or through the state's benefits portal, myCase, run by the Utah Department of Workforce Services, which screens for Utah Medicaid, Medicare Savings Programs, and Extra Help in one application.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Utah que aun no son elegibles automaticamente a traves de Medicaid de Utah, SSI o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare pueden solicitar la Ayuda Adicional a traves de dos canales: directamente con el Seguro Social, o a traves del portal de beneficios del estado, myCase, administrado por el Departamento de Servicios de la Fuerza Laboral de Utah.

heading.en: Common Reasons Extra Help Applications Get Denied in Utah
heading.es: Razones Comunes por las que se Niegan Solicitudes en Utah

paragraphs.en: Utah applicants who apply directly through Social Security or myCase are denied for a handful of predictable reasons, most of which can be corrected and resubmitted. Household income or countable resources over the limit are the two most common causes, followed by missing documentation of income or household composition.
paragraphs.es: Los solicitantes de Utah que aplican directamente a traves del Seguro Social o myCase son rechazados por razones predecibles, la mayoria corregibles y reenviables. Ingresos del hogar o recursos contables por encima del limite son las dos causas mas comunes, seguidas de documentacion faltante de ingresos o composicion del hogar.

list.en: Household income above 150% FPL once all household members' income is combined
list.es: Ingreso del hogar por encima del 150% del FPL una vez combinados los ingresos de todos los miembros

list.en: Countable resources above $16,590 (single) or $33,100 (married), often from an unexcluded retirement account
list.es: Recursos contables por encima de $16,590 (soltero) o $33,100 (casado), a menudo por una cuenta de jubilacion no excluida

list.en: Not yet enrolled in Medicare Part A or Part B at the time of application
list.es: Aun no inscrito en Medicare Parte A o Parte B al momento de la solicitud

list.en: Missing bank statements, tax documents, or proof of household composition
list.es: Faltan estados de cuenta bancarios, documentos fiscales o prueba de composicion del hogar

list.en: Failure to respond to a Social Security or DWS request for additional information within the given window
list.es: No responder a una solicitud del Seguro Social o DWS de informacion adicional dentro del plazo dado

heading.en: How to Appeal a Denial in Utah
heading.es: Como Apelar una Negacion en Utah

paragraphs.en: A Utah applicant denied Extra Help by Social Security has 60 days to request reconsideration in writing, either by mail or at a local Social Security field office. If the denial came through Utah Medicaid because the application was filed through myCase, the applicant can request a Utah DHHS fair hearing within 90 days of the notice, and free help is available from a local Area Agency on Aging benefits counselor or the Utah State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP).
paragraphs.es: Un solicitante de Utah a quien se le niega la Ayuda Adicional por el Seguro Social tiene 60 dias para solicitar una reconsideracion por escrito, ya sea por correo o en una oficina local del Seguro Social. Si la negacion vino a traves de Medicaid de Utah porque la solicitud se presento por myCase, el solicitante puede pedir una audiencia justa de DHHS dentro de 90 dias del aviso.

heading.en: Utah Medicaid Context: Utah's Medicaid Agency
heading.es: Contexto de Medicaid de Utah: la Agencia de Medicaid de Utah

paragraphs.en: Utah Medicaid is administered by the Utah Department of Health and Human Services and today covers roughly 380,000 Utahns, including low-income families, pregnant women, children, and adults under the ACA expansion group added in January 2020. For Medicare beneficiaries specifically, Utah Medicaid also runs the state's Medicare Savings Program, which pays Part B premiums and, for QMB enrollees, cost-sharing, and which doubles as an automatic gateway into Extra Help.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Utah es administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Utah y hoy cubre aproximadamente 380,000 residentes de Utah, incluidas familias de bajos ingresos, mujeres embarazadas, ninos y adultos bajo el grupo de expansion del ACA agregado en enero de 2020. Para los beneficiarios de Medicare especificamente, Medicaid de Utah tambien administra el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare del estado.

numberedSteps.es: Complete el Formulario SSA-1020 si solicita directamente a traves del Seguro Social, o la solicitud en linea de myCase si solicita a traves del portal estatal.

numberedSteps.en: Watch for a decision letter. If approved, coverage begins the month after approval or January 1, whichever is later.

en.question: What is the Extra Help income limit for a family of 4 in Utah in 2026?
en.answer: In 2026, a Utah household of 4 qualifies for Extra Help with income below $49,500 a year ($4,125 a month). This is the same nationwide limit used in every state except Alaska and Hawaii, since Extra Help thresholds are set federally by Social Security rather than by Utah Medicaid.

en.question: What counts as income for Extra Help in Utah?
en.answer: Extra Help counts gross income before taxes, including Social Security benefits, wages, pensions, and rental income, with a few exclusions. This differs from MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income), the calculation ACA marketplace subsidies and Utah Medicaid use, so a Utah resident's Extra Help eligibility and Utah Medicaid eligibility can differ even at similar income levels.

en.question: What documents do Utah applicants need for Extra Help?
en.answer: Utah applicants need a Social Security number or Medicare card, recent tax returns or W-2s, bank and investment statements, proof of any other income, proof of Utah residency, and household composition documentation. Applying through myCase can pull some records automatically, but income and asset statements are still required.

en.question: What happens if my Extra Help application is denied in Utah?
en.answer: A Utah applicant denied by Social Security has 60 days to request reconsideration in writing. If denied through Utah Medicaid after applying via myCase, the applicant can request a Utah DHHS fair hearing within 90 days. Free help is available from a Utah SHIP counselor or a local Area Agency on Aging.

en.question: Can I work and still get Extra Help in Utah?
en.answer: Yes, working does not disqualify a Utah resident from Extra Help as long as total gross household income stays below the 2026 limit for the household size, $23,940 for one person or $32,460 for a couple. Wages are counted as income the same as Social Security or pension income.

en.question: Is Utah a Medicaid expansion state, and does that matter for Extra Help?
en.answer: Yes. Utah expanded Medicaid under the ACA effective January 1, 2020, covering adults up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 for an individual in 2026). Because Utah expanded, there is no ACA coverage gap, and many Utah Medicaid-eligible adults who later enroll in Medicare are deemed automatically eligible for Extra Help.

en.question: How long does the Extra Help application take for Utah residents?
en.answer: Social Security typically decides an Extra Help application within 30 to 60 days of receiving all required documents. Applications submitted through myCase that also screen for Utah Medicaid can take a similar timeframe, since the Department of Workforce Services coordinates its determination with the federal Extra Help decision.

en.question: What is the difference between the Utah Medicare Savings Program and Medicare Extra Help?
en.answer: Utah's Medicare Savings Program (QMB, SLMB, QI) is a Utah Medicaid benefit that pays Medicare Part B premiums and, for QMB, cost-sharing. Medicare Extra Help is a separate federal program that only reduces Medicare Part D prescription drug costs. Utahns enrolled in a Medicare Savings Program get Extra Help automatically as a bonus benefit.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional para una familia de 4 en Utah en 2026?
es.answer: En 2026, un hogar de Utah de 4 personas califica para la Ayuda Adicional con ingresos menores a $49,500 al ano ($4,125 al mes). Este es el mismo limite nacional usado en todos los estados excepto Alaska y Hawaii.

es.question: Que cuenta como ingreso para la Ayuda Adicional en Utah?
es.answer: La Ayuda Adicional cuenta el ingreso bruto antes de impuestos, incluidos los beneficios del Seguro Social, salarios, pensiones e ingresos por alquiler, con algunas exclusiones. Esto difiere del MAGI, el calculo que usan los subsidios del mercado del ACA y Medicaid de Utah.

es.question: Que documentos necesitan los solicitantes de Utah para la Ayuda Adicional?
es.answer: Los solicitantes de Utah necesitan un numero de Seguro Social o tarjeta de Medicare, declaraciones de impuestos recientes o W-2, estados de cuenta bancarios y de inversion, prueba de otros ingresos, prueba de residencia en Utah y documentacion de composicion del hogar.

es.question: Que pasa si se niega mi solicitud de Ayuda Adicional en Utah?
es.answer: Un solicitante de Utah a quien se le niega por el Seguro Social tiene 60 dias para solicitar una reconsideracion por escrito. Si la negacion vino de Medicaid de Utah despues de solicitar por myCase, puede pedir una audiencia justa de DHHS dentro de 90 dias.

es.question: Puedo trabajar y aun recibir la Ayuda Adicional en Utah?
es.answer: Si, trabajar no descalifica a un residente de Utah de la Ayuda Adicional siempre que el ingreso bruto total del hogar se mantenga por debajo del limite de 2026 para el tamano del hogar, $23,940 para una persona o $32,460 para una pareja.

es.question: Es Utah un estado de expansion de Medicaid, y eso importa para la Ayuda Adicional?
es.answer: Si. Utah expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA a partir del 1 de enero de 2020, cubriendo a adultos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 para un individuo en 2026). Debido a que Utah expandio, no hay brecha de cobertura del ACA.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo toma la solicitud de Ayuda Adicional para los residentes de Utah?
es.answer: El Seguro Social generalmente decide una solicitud de Ayuda Adicional dentro de 30 a 60 dias de recibir todos los documentos requeridos. Las solicitudes enviadas por myCase que tambien evaluan Medicaid de Utah pueden tomar un tiempo similar.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Utah y la Ayuda Adicional de Medicare?
es.answer: El Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Utah (QMB, SLMB, QI) es un beneficio de Medicaid de Utah que paga las primas de la Parte B de Medicare. La Ayuda Adicional de Medicare es un programa federal separado que solo reduce los costos de medicamentos de la Parte D.
